summary: Make pad Thai an easy Old Town meal stop rather than a separate half-day outing. Thipsamai on Maha Chai Road provides a concrete specialist option: its signature Superb Padthai combines Chan rice noodles, shrimp oil and prawns inside an egg wrapper, cooked over charcoal. This is a richer seafood-led interpretation; the representative photograph shows Bangkok shrimp pad Thai, not a guaranteed Thipsamai serving.
whyGo: Compare a dedicated noodle specialist with versions you know from home.
